  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  February 03, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Council Chambers on the 9th floor
at 11:40 a.m.:

  Members Present: Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Debbie Crenshaw, City Treasurer
  Ken Campos, Legal

  Staff Present:  Teresa Estrada- Parks and Rec

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of February 03, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Kimberly Dodson - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for providing
  event planning services for the 2020 Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Day parade in the
  amount of $2,000.00. Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 11:50 a.m. Adjournment
